lines: A solo class can now pause, leave or finish, and the clock, the plan and the video move together.
Pause holds the clock, the plan and the video at the same second. The picture says Paused, and the stepper stays on.
Resume carries on from that second, with the video sought back onto the clock.
If the bike stops answering in a solo class, the ride waits for it, and an alert says so, with Reconnect.
Reconnect tries the bike at once. When it is back, the last level goes first, and the ride carries on.
The ride's own ticks stop while it is held, so the bike is watched on the app's second beat.
Leave goes straight to Class Start, with no confirmation, and nothing more goes to the bike.
At thirty minutes the clock stops, the video pauses, and Results opens.
The screen stays awake for the whole ride, and closing the tab mid-ride asks first.
On a phone, Pause is a forty-eight pixel icon. From tablet width, it has its label.
What the tests prove: six new specs and seven wake-lock cases, and every check is green.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
